newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW raises Orange target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW raises Orange target.

text.p: Analysts at BZW raised their price target for mobile 'phone operator Orange Plc to 240p and repeated a strong "buy" recommendation on the stock, market sources said on Friday.
The stock was up 1/2p at 179 by 1335 GMT in volume of 2.1 million shares, resisting a sharp, one percent decline in the FTSE 100 index.
The move comes after reports on Thursday that mobile 'phone operators would raise the cost of calls from BT lines to their subscribers.
Sources said BZW expected Orange's revenues per minute on calls from BT lines to more than double. Analysts at BZW were not immediately for comment.
